scenarios.name: artifact-creature-damage-may-create-thopter
scenarios.why: Whenever an artifact creature you control deals combat damage to a player, you may create a 1/1 blue Thopter artifact creature token with flying. The Sphinx itself is an artifact creature, so its own combat damage triggers it.

scenarios.name: nonartifact-attacker-creates-no-thopter
scenarios.why: Only an ARTIFACT creature's combat damage triggers the Sphinx. A Grizzly Bears dealing combat damage does not create a Thopter.
